actions.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Foreign Relations.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 395 - 20 (Roll no. 219). (text: CR H3727)
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 395 - 20 (Roll no. 219). (text: CR H3727)
Considered as unfinished business. (consideration: CR H3741)

At the conclusion of debate, the Yeas and Nays were demanded and ordered. Pursuant to the provisions of clause 8, rule XX, the Chair announced that further proceedings on the motion would be postponed.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 4216.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H3727-3728)
Mr. Baumgartner moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended.
Ordered to be Reported (Amended) by the Yeas and Nays: 48 - 0.
Committee Consideration and Mark-up Session Held
Referred to the House Committee on Foreign Affairs.

dimensions.assessment: Affects personnel within the Department of State and Department of Defense who conduct the reviews and prepare reports for Congress.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary of State, in coordination with the Secretary of Defense, shall carry out a review

dimensions.assessment: Administrative effect consisting of periodic reviews and reports rather than direct life-changing alterations for private citizens.
dimensions.evidence: submit to the appropriate congressional committees a report that contains the results of the review

dimensions.assessment: No specific appropriations or funding changes are authorized by the text.
Imposes a new reporting and review requirement regarding defense article lists without altering the underlying statutory authorities.
dimensions.evidence: carry out a review of defense articles and defense services that are eligible to be provided under the foreign military sales program

dimensions.assessment: Establishes an ongoing annual review and reporting requirement with permanent reach.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 1 year after the date of the enactment of this Act, and annually thereafter

missing_information: Specific cost estimates or budgetary authorizations for conducting the reviews.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires annual administrative reviews and reports regarding foreign military sales and direct commercial sales lists, creating moderate procedural requirements without direct funding or broad substantive changes to trade law.
